tasks.title: Essay: Priorities for the internship scheme
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing how to design a graduate internship scheme that is both accessible and responsible. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.
Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Review: Launch event of the internship scheme
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you attended the launch event of the new graduate internship scheme? Write a review for our specialist magazine. Describe what the event aimed to do, how well it presented the scheme's benefits, and whether you would recommend it to other graduates. The best reviews will be published in next month's issue.

tasks.title: Article: Making the internship scheme more inclusive
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our programme coordinator wants ideas to make the graduate internship scheme more inclusive. Write an article suggesting one practical way to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, explaining why it would work and what the benefits would be. We will share the best ideas with the planning team.

tasks.title: Email: Internship inquiry from partner organisation
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Internship placement for exchange student
paragraphs: I am writing on behalf of our partner organisation. One of our exchange students will be in your town next semester and is interested in joining your graduate internship scheme. Could you tell me what the application process involves? What kind of projects would an intern typically work on? Also, is there any financial support available for international participants?
I look forward to your reply.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Ms. Torres. You should explain the application steps, describe one typical project, and ask about accommodation options.
